# dsh-reasonix-agent

> Config backup mirror plus engineering knowledge base for a Windows-first dsh LLM agent harness and the reasonix runtime (2026-06 to 2026-10). For people who want real agent-harness config, patches and field-tested lessons, not a library.

## Backup mirror
- [dsh/](dsh/): settings.yaml, agent presets, cordis.patch.yml, launch-dsh.ps1 and other PowerShell tooling, backups/, plugins/, profiles/, peers/
- [agents/](agents/): skill bundles under [agents/skills/](agents/skills/) plus agents/.skill-lock.json
- [reasonix/](reasonix/) and [reasonix-home/](reasonix-home/): runtime home and memory corpus
- [goat-gateway/](goat-gateway/): local model gateway config; client profiles in [trae-cn/](trae-cn/), [trae-solo/](trae-solo/), [zcode-home/](zcode-home/), [zcode-appdata/](zcode-appdata/)

## Engineering notes
- [kb/](kb/): distilled conclusions, decision criteria and counter-examples from 300+ sessions and memory facts
- [README.md](README.md): repo layout, rename history, GH001 (file too large) incident and recovery

## Notes
- 2229 files, mixed PowerShell / Python / JavaScript / Markdown; daily 23:30 robocopy -> desensitize -> commit -> push.
- Credentials and server paths are stripped before commit; historical records keep their original wording.
